input.summary: Narrow TrueLink's Credit Data licence to processing to provide the services, and add a perpetual licence to Support Services results.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that we keep our data and receive a lasting licence to what we pay for, so we have narrowed TrueLink's Credit Data rights to processing solely to provide the Hosting Services and Support Services and added a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to the results of the Support Services. TrueLink's ownership of the Interface is unaffected.

ops.oldText: to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject
ops.newText: to process Credit Data solely to provide the Hosting Services and Support Services to Client, subject

ops.text: TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense all results of the Support Services for Client's business.
